clips.title: The story
paras: On the broken Thandol Span, Foggy MacKreel worries about a moonshine delivery bound for Southshore. Stranded on ruined lower masonry above a dizzying drop, the dwarf keeps his mind on the task.

Foggy MacKreel waits on broken pylons beneath the Thandol Span, calm despite his dangerous perch. Dark Iron sabotage and war damage shattered the bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. MacKreel gives little thought to rescue; he wants his potent moonshine delivered to the patrons of Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He hires passing travelers nimble enough to reach his ledge and finish the delivery for him.
